diagnostics.message: The bucket policy attached by aws_s3_bucket_policy.action_dist_bucket_policy grants access to wildcard principals ("*"), so AWS evaluates it as a "public" policy on PutBucketPolicy. Because aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block.action_dist sets block_public_policy = true, the PutBucketPolicy call fails with AccessDenied unless the public access block is already in place. Terraform will currently apply the two in parallel (the policy only depends on the bucket and the policy document), so adds a depends_on on the public access block.

The local-exec provisioner on null_resource.update_app registers the webhook URL (module.runners.webhook.endpoint) with the GitHub app. That endpoint string references only the aws_apigatewayv2_api resource, but the URL only serves requests once the "$default" stage (aws_apigatewayv2_stage.webhook, auto_deploy) is deployed. Nothing in the dependency chain references the stage, so the provisioner may run against a not-yet-deployed endpoint; add a depends_on on the stage so the API Gateway deployment exists before GitHub is pointed at it.
